summary: Scale alignment strengthened the weekly pivot terminal-hazard effect but did not rescue monthly, quarterly or yearly pivots. Daily/H1 passed every frozen gate at +1.02 pp terminal enrichment and 10/10 positive pairs; Weekly/H4 passed at +0.67 pp and 8/10 positive pairs. Monthly/D1, Quarterly/W1 and Yearly/MN1 failed their preregistered development/validation and uncertainty gates.

primary_findings.uncertainty: 95% CI [+0.85,+1.20], 10/10 pairs, empirical bootstrap p below first non-zero 5,000-draw resolution
95% CI [+0.33,+1.01], 8/10 pairs, empirical bootstrap p below first non-zero 5,000-draw resolution
95% CI [-3.59,+4.45], sparse and development/validation sign reversal

robustness: Daily/H1 positive in 10/10 pairs; every pair leave-one-out and named-level leave-one-out pooled effect positive.
Weekly/H4 positive in 8/10 pairs; every pair leave-one-out and named-level leave-one-out pooled effect positive.
Weekly/H4 combined effect +0.67 pp exceeded the frozen Weekly/H1 mismatch benchmark +0.28 pp.
Separate arithmetic recalculation reproduced all five primary combined effects exactly from aggregated counts.
Strict later-bar unit check confirmed a large-wick candidate candle cannot self-confirm as terminal.
limitations: The result does not support a universal fractal pivot effect; scale alignment only helped the weekly mapping.
Yearly/MN1 is severely sample-limited by the frozen ATR24 monthly warm-up.
Terminal endpoints remain retrospectively confirmed and structural midpoint prices are not executable P&L.
